title: Q-SEED-1: charter.json per system whose vectors generate the ranker's goals; a revision is versioned and re-ranks the backlog
body:
**Owner:** product-manager
**Trigger:** executor tick, driver order
**Done check:** file:foundation/charter.py
**Status:** closed

code-task: repo=ultrastable path=foundation/charter.py
See docs/doctrine/SEED.md. Replace the hand-written goals in doctrine/priorities.json with goals derived from each system's charter (tenant 0 and Practical Solutions first); a charter change must change the ranking, proven by a test.

size: M

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:12:26Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 175.2 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
